text_to_image_prompt: Premium refined semi-realistic 2.5D/3D character render, sculpted beautiful face, delicate skin microtexture and subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, fine individual hair strands, richly detailed fabric and metal physically based materials. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with fill, no colored cast, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Preserve CG material finish, not a photograph or flat illustration. An adult masculine fantasy traveler with long pale silver hair and braided sections, gray-blue eyes, pale skin, a refined oval face, straight brows and natural rose lips. Light gray layered coat over a white shirt, elaborate long silver earrings and layered silver necklaces. Side braid over his right shoulder (image-left in front), calf-length light gray embroidered open fantasy coat, ivory open-neck shirt, gray tailored slim trousers, silver-buckle belt, gray leather calf-high boots. Tall slender 188 cm, normal-sized face. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
